title: Fried Chicken with Potatoes and Vegetables (Frozen Meal)

content.title: About
content.content: Fried chicken with potatoes and vegetables is a ready‑to‑heat frozen meal that contains pieces of chicken breast, fried potatoes and a vegetable mix (carrot, peas, corn). It is designed for quick preparation in a microwave or on the stovetop.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The meal is packaged as a single‑serve convenience option.
The chicken is typically skinless, reducing the fat content.
The vegetable blend adds a variety of vitamins and minerals.
Freezing preserves flavor and nutritional quality.
Often chosen by athletes and people with busy lifestyles.

items.title: Rich in protein
items.content: Chicken breast provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle repair and growth.

items.title: Complex carbohydrates
items.content: Potatoes supply slowly digestible carbs that help maintain steady energy levels.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: The dish contains B6 and B12 vitamins important for metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Fiber from vegetables
items.content: Vegetable mix adds dietary fiber that supports healthy digestion.

items.title: Moderate sodium
items.content: When selected from low‑salt brands, the sodium level can be suitable for blood‑pressure management.

items.title: Chicken allergy
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to chicken proteins.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain frozen meals contain additives that may not be suitable for sensitive individuals.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Potatoes can raise blood sugar quickly, which should be considered by people with diabetes.

items.title: Need for thorough heating
items.content: Insufficient heating may leave live bacteria in the product.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Heat the package in the microwave for 3–4 minutes or on the stovetop, stirring occasionally. For extra flavor, add fresh herbs or a drizzle of olive oil.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the frozen meal at –18 °C (0 °F) or lower. Once thawed, consume immediately and do not store in the refrigerator for more than 2 hours.
